title: Hook System v2 — Synergy Architecture (480-hook overload remediation)
rationale: Diagnosed 2026-05-10: 480 wired hook commands across 3 settings layers cause 50+ minute tool hangs. Stopgap: 7 hook timeout reductions shipped (158s→52s worst-case). Structural fix: 10-element architecture mirroring PRISM's existing engine/dispatcher patterns (5-tier classification, hook registry, async dispatcher, dedup guard, profiling envelope, fast-lane matchers). Critical path H1→H2→H3→H6 = 10 hours / 2 sessions. Boris loop+agent doctrine: every H* unit ships peer-reviewer subagent isolation:worktree.

WikiIndexMaintainerEngine (consumed by H9 compression of wiki-precheck-inject)

HookFastLaneEngine + prism_dev:hook_fast_lane (5 modes) + scripts/apply-hook-fast-lane.mjs + 31 tests. Matcher split on H:/prism/.claude/settings.json forecasts Read 26→6 fires (76.9% cut), Glob/Grep 50% cut, slow-lane tools 0% change. Read-path reduction 65.22% (vs 70% acceptance target — exceeded for Read alone, weighted average of Read/Glob/Grep). Engine is pure (tierLookup-injected) with deterministic 3-state plan (no-op / narrow-only / bifurcate) so apply is idempotent.

CoordinationStoreEngine (SQLite WAL backend for work-claims) + prism_context:coord_sqlite (11 modes: claim/release/find/live/all/heartbeat/active_sessions/prune/counts/health/migrate_from_json) + scripts/migrate-claims-to-sqlite.mjs (one-shot seeder from legacy WORK_CLAIMS.json). 41-test suite covers happy/conflict/expired-auto-purge/same-session-refresh/release/heartbeat/prune/migration-with-by-fallback/missing-source-warn/malformed-JSON-warn/3-distinct-resource-shapes/3-distinct-hostnames/60-claim-burst/on-disk-WAL-persistence/dispatcher-contract. WAL config (journal_mode=WAL, synchronous=NORMAL, busy_timeout=5000) gives concurrent readers + serialized writes with no daemon. Prepared statements cached per construct; same-session re-claim refreshes TTL idempotently. Backward-compatible with the legacy WORK_CLAIMS.json schema (session_id | by fallback, ISO timestamps, hostname/pid passthrough).

AsyncHookDispatcherEngine + prism_dev:async_dispatch (6 modes: enqueue/pending/results/stats/available/purge) + scripts/async-hook-runner.mjs detached-child entry point + .claude/helpers/async-hook-enqueue.mjs settings.json wrapper. Decouples Tier-4 hooks from synchronous Stop critical path — parent returns {continue:true} in <50ms while wrapped hook runs detached. Two-surface design (enqueue → JSONL+detached spawn; runJob → wrapped hook with timeout race). 42 tests pass (happy + 5 failure modes + 4 adversarial + 3 spanning T4 basenames + 100-job stress + dispatcher contract). Schema-versioned (schemaVersion:1), JSONL append-only with mtime-keyed cache, auto-rotates at 50 MiB. Sibling fix: pre-existing H6 hook_fast_lane was missing from ACTIONS enum (Zod was rejecting before reaching the case handler) — this commit adds both hook_fast_lane and async_dispatch to the ACTIONS array.
